name: E-Eval
description: With the accelerating development of Large Language Models (LLMs), many LLMs are beginning to be used in the Chinese K-12 education domain. The integration of LLMs and education is getting closer and closer, however, there is currently no benchmark for evaluating LLMs that focuses on the Chinese K-12 education domain. Therefore, there is an urgent need for a comprehensive natural language processing benchmark to accurately assess the capabilities of various LLMs in the Chinese K-12 education domain.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for Chinese K-12 education; useful for assessing educational-domain LLMs but not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Chinese-language educational benchmark; likely includes exam-style questions and may be sensitive to training-data contamination from public exam materials.
